info.title: Skotos Control Plane API
info.description: Control Plane REST API for managing Skotos organizations, projects, environments, feature flags, targeting rules, segments, Big Segments, custom RBAC roles, teams, approval workflows, release pipelines, workflows, SSO/SCIM, code references, scheduling, triggers, webhooks, usage analytics, experimentation, guarded rollouts, migration flags, synced segments, data export sinks, simulations, revisions, audit logs, API tokens, and members.

200.description: Login succeeded; sets HttpOnly skotos_session cookie

post.summary:
High-throughput unauthenticated CDP / Reverse-ETL sync endpoint (`POST /api/v1/synced-segments/ingest/{token}`).
Authenticates via one-time hashed sync token (`sk_sync_...`), mutates Big Segment membership,
and triggers OutboxWorker Zstd hash-block sync to R2/S3 & NATS!

ClauseOp.description: Exact 15 canonical clause operators locked in PROJECT.md.

Context.description: Evaluation context: either a single context ({"kind":"user","key":"...",...}) or a multi-context ({"kind":"multi","user":{...},"organization":{...}})

ContextMeta.description: Metadata attached to a single evaluation context (`_meta`).

EngineeringInsights.description: Engineering Insights: DORA velocity & stability metrics + Flag Health.

EvaluationDetail.description: Detailed result returned by the evaluation engine.

EvaluationReason.description: Structured explanation of why a variation was served.

allocations.description: Expected allocation weights in basis points summing to 100_000 (used for SRM).

FlagPatchInstruction.description: Canonical 23-variant semantic instruction patch enum for feature flag mutations.

FlagVariationMonitoring.description: Per-variation health metrics displayed directly on Flag Detail pages (Feature Monitoring).

maxRegressionPct.description: Relative degradation percentage threshold (e.g. `10.0` = 10% worse than control triggers alert/rollback).

LiveEvalDebugEvent.description: Ephemeral event published onto `skotos.debug.{env_id}` for the Live Events Debugger.

eventKey.description: SDK custom event key tracked via `client.track(event_key, ctx, data, value)`.

metricKeys.description: Ordered metric keys (step order matters for `funnel` groups).

checkRatio.description: Consistency check sampling ratio (`1` = every call, `10` = 1 in 10, `0` = disabled).

MutualExclusionLayer.description: Non-overlapping traffic space (`0..100_000` basis points) isolating concurrent experiments.

PatchSummaryItem.description: Human-readable description of a single semantic patch instruction for UI diffs and audit logs.

PolicyStatement.description:
Declarative resource-path RBAC statement (LaunchDarkly-compatible grammar).

Resource paths follow `proj/{project}:env/{env}:flag/{flag}`,
`proj/{project}:env/{env}:segment/{segment}`, `team/{team}`, `role/{role}`,
`webhook/{webhook}`, `member/*`, or `*`.

ProblemDetails.description: RFC 9457 `application/problem+json` error payload returned by all `control-api` 4xx/5xx responses.

SegmentPatchInstruction.description: Semantic instruction patches for segment mutations.

VariationSufficientStats.description:
Compact sufficient statistics per variation (`n`, `conversions`, `sum`, `sum_sq`),
allowing Frequentist & Bayesian inference in O(1) without pulling raw rows from OLAP.
